stem.text: A cell is connected in series with an ammeter and a variable resistor. A voltmeter is used to measure the p.d. across the variable resistor. The resistance of the variable resistor is varied, and the p.d. and the current are recorded.
The graph shows the variation with current of the p.d. across the variable resistor.

stem.alt: Gridded graph of p.d./V (vertical axis, 0 to 1.8) against current/mA (horizontal axis, 0 to 80). A straight line falls from the top left of the grid towards the lower right and ends at about 70 mA.

stem.text: What is the internal resistance of the cell?
